title: `??=` reads its target the way `??` does and is typed as the value it wrote, and `??+=`, `??-=` and `??.=` start from the zero of the target's type
scope:
what `??=` reads, what it writes and what its value's type is, and three new assignment operators
built on the same read. The plain `=`, narrowing after a write and every other compound operator are
unchanged and stay with their own records.
validatedBy: the conformance and reject cases the two rules' `guardedBy` names, and the hooked-property test in `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/tests.rs`.
